verdict.line: You lose if you tunnel autos into his 50+ Fury window; you win if you time W (Defiant Dance) into his empowered hits and punish his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: This is a 49.4% winrate lane over 733 games because both champions win different windows: Renekton spikes when Fury crosses 50 and again at level 6 with R (Dominus), while Irelia's E (Flawless Duet) into Q (Bladesurge) reset gives her the stronger planned all-in whenever his kit is down. The lane is decided by who trades on their own cooldown, not the other's.

theirWindow.what: His Q (Cull the Meek) deals more damage and heals more, and his W (Ruthless Predator) upgrades to a 3-hit stun lasting 1.5s that also destroys shields — do not stand and trade autos here, back off a step and let him spend it on minions.

yourWindow.when: his Q, W, and E all on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and open with E (Flawless Duet, 16s cooldown at rank 1) for the stun and Mark, then Q (Bladesurge, 10s cooldown at rank 1) into the marked target to refresh Q and keep dashing — this is the all-in OP.GG's own tip is describing.

powerCurve.note: Q sustain and range win early auto trades
E stun+Mark unlocks your planned all-in
Dominus grants bonus health, AoE burst
W blocks his empowered W/E damage

start.why: Run in 92.2% of games at 49.2% winrate over 788 games — the extra HP and sustain let you match his Q lifesteal in early trades.

boots.why: Taken in 88.7% of games — flat physical damage reduction directly counters his auto-attack and Fury-empowered ability damage.

core.why: First item in the 54.6% winrate path (141 games) — the on-hit true damage and slow help you win extended duels once Fury runs out.
Second item in the same 26.2% pick-rate path — scales your split-push and 1v1 power once the lane stabilizes.
Closes out the highest-volume core path — magic resist plus attack speed lets you out-trade him after level 10.

situational.when: you are trading damage back and forth all game and need to survive his burst windows
you want a faster all-in spike instead of the sustained-duel path (62.1% winrate, 66 games)
you are ahead and want insurance against his level 6 Dominus all-in

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through the extended trades this matchup demands and gives you the healing to match his Q sustain once fully stacked.

summoners.why: Run in 85.6% of games at 51.9% winrate — Ignite lets you close out the level 3-5 E-into-Q all-in window before he can Cull the Meek sustain back.

playing.title: Track his Fury bar constantly
playing.detail: At 50+ Fury his Q heals and hits harder and his W becomes a 3-hit, 1.5s stun that strips shields. Disengage rather than trade into it.

playing.title: Charge W into his engage
playing.detail: W (Defiant Dance) takes reduced physical damage while charging — pop it the moment he commits Q, W, or E so his highest-damage tool lands on a mitigated hit.

playing.title: All-in on cooldown windows
playing.detail: Once his Q, W, and E are all down, land E for the stun and Mark, then Q into him — Q refreshes on a Marked target, so you can keep dashing through the trade.

playing.title: Respect level 6 exactly
playing.detail: Dominus gives him bonus health and AoE damage around him the instant he hits 6. Don't be in melee range when his level 6 lands unless your own cooldowns are up.

playing.title: Bait Slice and Dice
playing.detail: E (Slice and Dice, 16s cooldown at rank 1) is his only gap closer and armor-shred tool when empowered. Once it's down he has no way to re-enter range — this is your window to walk him down.

playing.title: Build BotRK before full damage
playing.detail: Blade of The Ruined King's on-hit damage scales off his max health, which spikes hard when he ults — prioritize it first so his Dominus form doesn't make him untouchable.

playing.title: Don't fight through his Q sustain at level 1-2
playing.detail: Cull the Meek heals him on every early trade. Farm safely with auto-Q pokes rather than extended melee exchanges until you have E at level 3.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all winrate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reading of Fury windows, cooldown timing, and trade patterns is my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Absorb Renekton’s skill damage with a well-timed [W]. Engage aggressively with 4 stacks [P] ready whenever Renekton’s skills are on cooldown.
